production_entry.import_mode: normal package imports and public backend dispatch

timing_policy.event_scope: stream elapsed including possible host launch gaps; not sum of kernel durations
timing_policy.wall_scope: synchronized wall time including event instrumentation, amortized over iterations
timing_policy.prepared_scope: prebuilt metadata and reusable workspaces; direct score+TopK timing
timing_policy.public_scope: unchanged public API, includes request mapping and allocations
timing_policy.native_scope: fused kernel with prebuilt row table and weights; no separate score/TopK latency
timing_policy.adapter_scope: unchanged native adapter includes metadata construction and output normalization
timing_policy.stage_note: isolated TopK reads frozen scores; isolated stages are not additive or a kernel-mode acceptance metric
timing_policy.workload_scope: three structural diagnostic cases, not a replacement for the repository benchmark suite

timeline.caveat: Uncovered intervals are not proof of host starvation: dependencies, unselected activity and other processes can contribute. Use CPU launch events/flows in the raw trace.
